title: Monthly PPI by Stage of Processing
description: Monthly producer price index (PPI) by stage of processing, per the SITC classification.

fields.name: series
fields.title: Series Type
fields.description: [String] Series type, either absolute values ('abs'), year-on-year growth ('growth_yoy') or month-on-month growth ('growth_mom')

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 as the data is at monthly frequency

fields.name: stage
fields.title: Stage of Processing
fields.description: [String] Stage-of-processing code, to be matched using the 'code' column in the [Stage of Processing Lookup](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/sitc_sop). The lookup table will give you the English and Malay definitions.

fields.name: index
fields.title: Index
fields.description: [Float] Level of producer prices, expressed as an index with base 2010 = 100

methodology: The Producer Price Index (PPI) measures the level of prices received by the producer at the first stage of commercialisation (also known as the ex-factory price), relative to a base year (2010 = 100). Ex-factory prices exclude indirect taxes and any transport charges invoiced separately by the producer, unless the transport charges are too difficult to segregate (usually because the firm utilises their own transport facilities rather than hiring transport services). For a deeper understanding of the PPI compilation methodology and related concepts, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/ppi).
caveat: Data for the most recent 3 months may be revised in subsequent releases.
publication: [Producer Price Index, Jul 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/ppi_2026-07), the latest edition of the monthly producer price statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on producer prices](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/producer-prices) where you can explore this data in a more interactive manner.
